question: Which of the following players is associated with para-badminton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Krishna Nagar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Krishna Nagar is a para-badminton player, and is associated with the following:
 
• 2020 Summer Paralympics: Won a gold medal in the men's singles SH6 event 
 
• 2024 Paris Paralympics: Defended his title and competed in the men's singles badminton event 
 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award: Recipient of the award for para-badminton 
 
• World champion: Won the title in Thailand earlier in 2024 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sumit Antil – A para-athlete from India specializing in javelin throw. He won a gold medal at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics in the Men's Javelin Throw F64 event, setting a new world record with a throw of 68.55 meters.
 
• Manish Narwal – A para-shooter who won a gold medal in the Men's 50m Pistol SH1 event at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics. His achievement was notable for his resilience, winning the event with a Paralympic record score.
 
• Avani Lekhara – A para-shooter who won two medals at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics: a gold in the 10m Air Rifle Women SH1 and a bronze in the 50m Rifle 3 Position Women SH1. She became the first Indian woman to win gold at the Paralympics.
